design_relevance.inference: A bounded onboarding/separation process trace is a plausible C01 service-line archetype because a historical audit identified information and monitoring questions. This is a research design lead, not proof that the historical conditions persist.
design_relevance.candidate_subcase: One prospectively agreed client and onboarding OR separation service category with a complete eligible closed-period cohort, including delayed, corrected, withdrawn and completed cases.
design_relevance.smallest_decision: Determine whether service case chronology and responsibility-attributed delays can be linked to retained local work, provider processing and outcomes before designing an operational alternative.
design_relevance.protect_existing_controls: Confirm current workflow tooling, client responsibilities and completed remediation first; avoid proposing another dashboard or duplicate tracking layer merely because the historical report mentioned weak monitoring.
design_relevance.scope_limit: Do not extrapolate the2021–2023 audit or its16-client context to2026 operations, post-handover clients, allRSCE functions or institution-wide waste.

minimum_extra_evidence_before_adjudicati: Current SLA and responsibility matrix, including client versus provider clock-start rules
Current workflow-tool description and version, relevant recommendation closure/remediation receipts
Complete eligible case-population receipt, exclusions, counts and missingness
Stage-level chronology and reason/role attribution sufficient to distinguish provider processing from waiting for client documentation

proposed_contract_extension.boundary: These extra fields are not falsely presented as already authorized E01 fields. No actual values, staff names, employment files, identifiers or re-identification maps belong in public Git.

evidence_path.prospective_guardrail_design: Preserve payroll/appointment and separation-payment continuity, required controls, confidentiality and service obligations. Establish baseline and applicable SLA, then freeze comparison/threshold rules before outcome evaluation; retain no-change outcomes.

f03_boundary: Historical public excerpts can anchor a specific hypothesis and refine research design. They do not themselves satisfy all seven VALIDATION_READY checks or any OPERATIONALLY_VALIDATED/FINANCIALLY_VALIDATED gate.
